meta.title: The Jungle in the Living Room
meta.textType: story: a cartoon story with key words

paragraphs: It rained all Sunday, and Tom was at home. The rain was loud on the window, and the sky was gray. "This day is boring," he said. "I don't have any new games." Lily sat on the sofa with a book about the jungle. Pip sat under the table and watched them. "Why don't we make a jungle here?" asked Lily. "A jungle in the living room?" said Tom. "Yes! It's a good idea."

They put blankets on the chairs and the table. Then they took Mom's plants from the window. Lily put a toy parrot on a big plant. "I'm the explorer," she said. "I'm a monkey," said Tom. He climbed on the sofa and shouted. Pip hid under a blanket. Lily read from her book, "A parrot lives in the jungle." Tom made a loud monkey noise, and Lily laughed. "Look! A tiger!" said Lily. Pip came out and said, "Woof!" The game was very exciting.

Then Mom came in from the kitchen. "Why are my plants here?" she asked. "It's a jungle, Mom!" said Lily. Mom looked at the room and laughed. "A jungle needs dinner, too," she said. "I cooked rice and fish for dinner," she said. "Are the explorers hungry?" "Yes!" said Tom and Lily. They ate dinner in the jungle, and Pip ate under the table. The rain stopped, but nobody went out. "This day isn't boring now," said Tom.
text.summary: It rains all Sunday, and Tom is bored. Lily makes a jungle in the living room, and the children play there until Mom cooks dinner.
